QuestInfo.name: Meaning of Oblivion
QuestInfo.0: Record Keeper wants to speak with you. Go see the Record Keeper.
QuestInfo.1: Record Keeper wants you to overcome the seductions of the oblivion. Go remember your painful past in #b#MDmirrorD_328_2_##k.
QuestInfo.2: You let the Oblivion fragment's words to let your self go pass in #MDmirrorD_328_2_#

0.0: Oh, the one who walks the path of the past... What is oblivion to you?\r\n#L0##bIt is where I will end those who have wronged me. #l\n#k
0.1: Oblivion to you is like an indulgence from the past that you can't forget. I want to test you...can you defy the irresistible call of oblivion? What say you?

yes.0: Those in #b#MDmirrorD_328_2_##k will tempt you...they will tell you how it's so much better to forget everything and let it all go. Don't be content with the warmth of #r#t4009119##k and #r#t4009120##k. This is all I can tell you.

no.0: Oblivion is when you forget something, not lose something.

1.0: Oh, the one who overcame oblivion... Continue your quest.

default.0: #r#t4009119##k and #r#t4009120##k will continue to test your will...
